section0_doubtful_checked.question: Huki bez .cmd na chistom Windows (bez Git-Bash v PATH) upadut?
section0_doubtful_checked.fact: Git for Windows 2.46.0 ustanovlen (C:/Program Files/Git). Git sam vyzyvaet huki cherez svoy sh.exe (C:/Program Files/Git/bin/sh.exe, usr/bin/sh.exe - suschestvuyut). 'where bash' v PowerShell pust (PATH sessii ne soderzhit Git\bin), NO dlya git-hukov eto ne vazhno - git rezolvit sh otnositelno svoego kornya. Risk tolko pre-push:15 'bash hooks/coder-dom-verify.sh' po imeni - Git pri vypolnenii huka dobavlyaet svoy bin v PATH; nizkiy risk, zafiksirovan TD-DEV-36.
